source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For Exchange2013 or newer, the initial operation requests MarkAsJunk with movement, validates response classes/count and returns moved IDs. The folder success callback then validates header cardinality, locally copies to Junk or Inbox, writes new protocol IDs and deletes source data. Local errors can follow remote success and partial commits; missing-ID inputs and absent destination are not all covered by tests. The historical supplied simple message listener has no fallible interface, so optional error notification is not a guaranteed copy-listener completion. Older-server support comes in 3375, and current safe orchestration is later. No network, store or test ran.
title: EWS junk success precedes local ID reconciliation and does not cover every failure callback
